C.  DISCUSSION ITEM(S)

There were no Discussion items.

D.  COMMITTEE REPORT(S)

There were no Committee Reports.

E.  NEW BUSINESS

There were no New Business items.

F.  ORAL STAFF REPORT(S)

Pablo Rubio, City Clerk, announced that the Nomination period for City Council candidates opens on
Monday, July 18, 2022.

G.  CITY ATTORNEY REPORT(S)

There were no City Attorney Reports.

H.  ORAL COUNCIL REPORT(S)

Councilmember Alvarado announced that he visited our Sister City, Venustiano, Carranza – San
Pedro; attended the Hawaiian Gardens Annual car show; and went to Sacramento on June 14, 2022 as
Chair of the JPA to speak with legislators with regards to the card club moratorium.

Mayor Pro Tem Del Rio announced that she visited our Sister City, Venustiano, Carranza – San Pedro;
and attended the Hawaiian Gardens Annual car show.

Mayor Roa announced that he attended the City’s 4th of July event; attended the Hawaiian Gardens
Annual car show; and requested staff to explore alternatives for street sweeping and trash days, when
there is a holiday.
